name: 43227 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43227 (Columbus) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43227 (Columbus) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43227 (Columbus) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
